blurb: Guests visit the estate winery on the Beamsville Bench to explore and experience critically acclaimed Burgundian-style wines made from Niagara terroir. Tastings and immersive wine experiences focus on Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, with intimate group sizes. The estate features a terrace with views of vineyards and the Toronto skyline, and a members-only lounge.
extraNote: Estate winery at 4260 Mountainview Rd, Beamsville, ON
